source_policy: Primary papers and official author/organization repositories only; source reading, no installation, download of models, or inference.

sources.title: Grounding DINO
sources.scope: Image/text -> boxes and phrase similarity; no native-corner visibility output.

sources.title: Scaling Open-Vocabulary Object Detection
sources.scope: Box-based open-vocabulary detection/self-training; zero-shot categories do not mean no real-image pretraining.

sources.title: DINOv2: Learning Robust Visual Features without Supervision
sources.scope: Patch-token feature API; not the Grounding DINO detector.

sources.title: LUVLi Face Alignment
sources.scope: Location/uncertainty/visibility joint model; GT v gates location loss; v includes external-occluded annotated points.

sources.title: PVNet
sources.scope: Pixel voting/amodal projected keypoint locations and uncertainty; real+render/cut-paste in original experiments.

sources.title: FoundPose
sources.scope: RGB/CAD/instance identity+mask, DINOv2 template correspondence; official code omits featuremetric refinement.

sources.title: EPOS
sources.scope: Many-to-many pixel/surface-fragment correspondences and pose hypotheses; benchmark localization may use GT instance counts.

sources.title: SurfEmb
sources.scope: Multimodal dense correspondence distributions; sampling/scoring/refinement; synthetic-only training results are for dense object-specific pose setting.

sources.title: BlenderProc
sources.scope: PBR/procedural data and instance-level sim-to-real; not a native-visibility success proof.

sources.title: Pix2Pose
sources.scope: Coordinate reconstruction/expected error/symmetry; original experiments use real RGB/pose/mask.

sources.title: GDR-Net
sources.scope: Dense geometry/mask intermediate supervision, GT mask coordinate loss; not frozen scalar head or synthetic-only evidence.

sources.title: ZebraPose
sources.scope: Hierarchical surface codes; published solver path with maximum_model_number=1 is not a multiple-pose ranker.

sources.title: Good Features to Track
sources.scope: Two-direction image evidence and aperture ambiguity; OpenCV is an implementation reference, not original authors' repository.

sources.title: Segment Anything
sources.scope: Prompted instance masks do not supply native keypoint identity or external/self occlusion labels.
